horizondb-single-replica-production.title: One replica means no zone resilience
horizondb-single-replica-production.body: This production estimate has a single compute replica. Microsoft states a HorizonDB cluster needs at least two replicas to be zone resilient (the storage is zone resilient already, but compute is not). A second replica is billed at the full vCore price, so add it to the estimate if the workload needs to survive a zone outage.

citation.quote: In order to have zonal resilience, you need atleast two replicas on the cluster.
